summary: The compact gabled silhouette, pale roof, high square gable opening, low horizontal opening, and offset entry make the studio recognizable, but the masonry treatment conflicts with the characteristic timber-clad appearance.

orientation.summary: SV1 is geolocated in the +u/+v quadrant and looks SSE toward the studio, exposing the NW-facing +u gable and its NE side. The reference cues place the low opening and understated right-hand entry on that viewed gable. The render’s sole door is likewise on +u at the right side; no duplicate principal portal appears on the other three labeled faces.

issues.problem: The model uses conspicuous red brickwork, while the reference shows brown timber/shingle-like wall cladding; this changes a defining visual characteristic.
issues.fix: Replace the brick courses with simplified warm-brown timber or square-shingle cladding, retaining the dark base and restrained trim.
